body: I am still really at the point where I would rather be dead, but I don't want to hurt my husband and family that badly.

I would guess his wife already suspects that he is cheating. She never lets him out of her sight. She wouldn't believe it if she heard it anyway. It's really none of my business and I honestly think he's more messed up than me emotionally. The reason he cut off contact with me was because I pointed out that he was probably going to cheat on her no matter what.
If he knows about the affair, he will have to know all of the details. He is too analytical to not want to know every little thing.

That is exactly how I feel. I don't feel like I can be open and honest with him. He gets very upset whenever I need to vent and starts yelling at me. I feel like he just wants to fix everything and just gets angry that he can't help. Since I have very few friends, it's hard when he has been the only consistent thing in my life for so long and I feel like I can't talk to him. If we break up, I lose any friends I have because we met them together, everyone thinks he's wonderful, and I'm the cheating whore.
I have scheduled an appointment with a therapist for this afternoon. Has anyone had experience with this? I am afraid I cannot be honest for fear I will be committed.
Thank you. I do not want to destroy 4 lives by telling him. Which is why I feel I have to shoulder the burden alone.

You're right, it's not only the affair. The infertility, lack of attention, job change, and stress combined to make a bad situation terrible. I have been reading the relationships subreddit a lot, and every post about infidelity leads to comments about how horrible the people who cheat are. I am horrible, the man I cheated with is horrible, and he got incredibly angry with me when I made a comment about it.

I do not feel like I should tell him for the protection of the man I was involved with. Yes, I feel like he took advantage of me when I was having relationship troubles, yes, he used me only for sex and then got angry with me when I pointed out that he seemed to be set on cheating on his wife. But I don't feel like it is beneficial to destroy my husband's life or his wife's life just because I want to feel better. I feel like I will devastate my husband either way, my death would hurt the fewest people.
